# Paparats MCP

> Paparats MCP is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted MCP server for semantic code search
> across many repositories, for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot and any other
> MCP client. It indexes code with tree-sitter AST chunking, builds a cross-chunk symbol
> graph, attaches git history and ticket references to every chunk, and stores vectors in
> Qdrant using local llama.cpp embeddings. Code never leaves the machine by default.
> There is no hosted version.

## Facts

- Install: download examples/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml and projects.yml, then `docker compose up -d` (needs only Docker with Compose v2); or the CLI: `npm install -g @paparats/cli && paparats install`, then `paparats add <path-or-github-repo>` (needs Node.js 24+)
- Package: @paparats/cli (npm); MCP Registry id io.github.IBazylchuk/paparats-mcp; license MIT
- Endpoints (Streamable HTTP, default port 9876): /mcp (coding), /support/mcp (support), /knowledge/mcp (docs-only, opt-in, bearer auth)
- Embeddings: bge-code-v1 for code (1536d), Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B for docs, glossary and architectural memory (1024d), served locally by llama.cpp llama-server + llama-swap; OpenAI and Voyage are opt-in
- Languages with AST chunking and symbol extraction: TypeScript (incl. TSX), JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Terraform/HCL
- Freshness: the indexer checks each repo for changes every 10 minutes (git ls-remote or file mtime/size fingerprint) and runs a full pass every few hours; POST /trigger on port 9877 reindexes on demand; there is no file watcher
- Multi-repo: projects in the same group share one Qdrant collection and are searched together
- Not included: code editing or refactoring tools, BM25 keyword search on the code layer (the docs layer is hybrid)
